commit_message: Require 32K context for Goose ACP Authoring
pr_title: Require 32K context for Goose ACP Authoring
pr_body:
## Summary
- keep Managed Local physical context planning unchanged and add an admission-only consumer requirement type
- require 32,768 physical tokens for Goose ACP Authoring before Managed Local endpoint startup
- make AI Studio and Benchmark Campaign share the same Goose configuration admission contract, validating every campaign candidate
- document the 32K rationale and preserve Goose-owned compaction/history responsibility in ADR 0166

## Validation
Use the repository Windows Validation workflow. This changes engine-editor Rust plus ADR 0166 and does not intentionally change UI layout or appearance.
